messages:
Maria L: thinking about tenant-controlled rate limiting for Private (VPC) installs — proposal: expose minimal API + console UX so customers can declare per-org/per-key baseline qps and a separate burst token bucket. quick feedback before RFC.
Alex P: enforcement plane? dataplane in-customer-vpc vs control-plane token issuance?
Maria L: enforce in customer VPC dataplane. control plane only for policy distribution & audit. avoid cross-vpc hops.
Jun: +1. trust model: who can edit? org-admin only? key owners?
Priya: org-admin-only + audit logs. read-only view for devs. console should show active bursts and recent denials.
Carlos: platform-level hard cap required. infra defines platform_max to prevent infinite bursts.
Maria L: add "platform_max" enforced by infra with alerts when close.
Alex P: suggested policy sketch:
```
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "default": {"qps": 10, "burst_capacity": 200, "refill_rate_per_sec": 20},
  "keys": {"k-abcd": {"qps": 50, "burst_capacity": 1000}}
}
```
Jun: be explicit about units (qps, tokens/sec).
Priya: UX: console should let them simulate a burst and show estimated cost delta. customers worry about surprise billing.
Carlos: telemetry: emit per-tenant metrics: allowed, throttled, burst_consumed, burst_replenish, and a tag for customer-set vs inherited.
Alex P: rollout: opt-in on Private installs, default disabled. beta for select customers with checklist (logging, SSO admin mapping, infra max defined).
Maria L: provide migration/import tool in console to convert existing per-key quotas and preview changes.
Jun: implementation note: token bucket decisions must be deterministic across nodes. consider sharded leases or a sidecar central token source in-vpc.
Carlos: for high-throughput tenants recommend Dedicated; refuse huge bursts in Private and point to Dedicated.
Maria L: security/audit: every policy change emits an immutable audit event, optionally signed by customer KMS.
Priya: expose endpoint for customers to fetch policy diff history.
Maria L: next steps: I'll write RFC with schema, console mockups, rollout checklist. tagging infra/sre/security to review. @Alex P @Jun @Priya @Carlos plz send quick comments by EOD tomorrow :thumbsup:
